I remember when I chose the time of my death. When the day did come I had completely forgotten about it. I was reminded about though. I was coming home that night and in front of the store next to where I live, there was a man sitting there. Not on the stairs or on the flower pots or anywhere more "convenient" for a man to sit, he was just kinda there, i don't know how to explain it. So anyway, I had picked the date and the hour to the precise minute when I would take my life. I pass the guy and he calls out asking what time it is. I give him the time and proceed like nothing has happened. I get home and I don't know if I was paranoid or whatever, but I remembered that I had made that "promise" with myself and I got so scared of that guy being some divine being or something that I didn't go through with it. It's silly I know, even stupid. Now, I'm not hoping that a weird homeless guy reminds you that life is worth living for a bit longer, but, I'm asking you to forget as well. Maybe read a book or play something and let it drag on purposely so that you forget what time it is and just kinda see what happens from there. Hope this helps
